verdict.rationale: First-party docs state you can install and run your own Supabase on your own computer, server, or cloud infrastructure, with no telemetry. A Docker guide supports non-interactive setup. The public supabase/auth GitHub repo documents server configuration options, and Auth can be used standalone. Missing for 10: self-hosting docs specific to running Auth on its own (the guides cover the whole Supabase stack), and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted Auth deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Install and run your own Supabase on your computer, server, or cloud infrastructure.
Self-hosted Supabase **does not phone home or collect any telemetry**.
Use `-y` to run non-interactively with default values.
You can use Supabase Auth as a standalone product
